claim_boundary.acquisition: GT and Low are independent real acquisitions of the same field, but have been selected, ECC-registered, and intersection-cropped by the publisher. The evaluator preserves the archive's native uint16 intensities.
claim_boundary.benchmark_scope: This development result is separate from and must not be pooled with the frozen synthetic reporting split.
claim_boundary.coordinate_truth: Coordinates are exact only in the coordinate system of the publisher-registered Low/GT pair and the deterministic crop construction. Residual publisher-registration error is unknown.
claim_boundary.task_scope: The equal-field-of-view publisher pair is converted to a reference-in-search task by digital cropping. This is not native cross-magnification or microscope-stage ground truth.

preprocessing.intensity: Native single-channel TIFF array retained without clipping or per-image rescaling
preprocessing.reference_construction: Nominal 0.1x GT crop enlarged to the registered frame shape with OpenCV INTER_LANCZOS4

selection.low_frame_position_assignment: zero-based lexicographic Low member index selects the same-rank informative GT crop
selection.position_strategy: For each GT, rank a fixed 9x9 interior grid by GT-only mean absolute Gaussian high-pass residual; greedily retain the five highest-scoring non-overlapping crops with row/column tie breaks.
selection.rule: Use only image pairs under the publisher's Test split. After validating the archive layout, sort eligible registered Low/GT pairs by normalized member path and use every eligible pair. For each sharp GT, evaluate a fixed 9x9 interior grid using mean absolute residual after Gaussian blur (sigma 3 pixels), greedily retain the five highest-scoring non-overlapping crops with deterministic row/column tie breaks, and assign the same-rank crop to the corresponding sorted Low frame. Selection uses no Low frame, prediction, localization score, or result threshold.

acquisition.registration_note: The publisher manually selected low-quality images and registered them to high-quality images with ECC after manual translation initialization. The prepared archive retains single-channel uint16 TIFF arrays.
